title: HostEventCaseViewDocument
description: Server-owned manager projection of one practical guest help request, written ahead of time by triggers on eventAssistanceCases, eventAttendees, events and organizers. view holds the row the retired listEventAssistanceCases callable returned for this case. A view exists only for a case owned by the event lead in live mode; a safety-owned, rehearsal or deleted case has none. A case that fails validation records sourceCoverage invalidSource and incompleteSource, keeps the previous view (null when there was none) and never throws. The manager choices for a handoff are not stored here: the phone builds them from the organizer document. Managers list an event's views under rules by organizerId, eventId and status; authority comes from the organizer document, never from the view.
x-owner: Host event case view evaluator (hostReadModels event case view triggers)

caseId.description: Equals the document id and the case's caseId.

organizerId.description: The case's organizer; rules key on it.

status.description: The case's status, for the queue filter.

receivedAt.description: When the guest's request arrived, in milliseconds.

revision.description: Increases by one with every committed evaluation that changed the document.

evaluatedAt.description: When the evaluation that last changed the document committed; the time the view row describes.

sourceCoverage.description: Whether the last evaluation read every source validly. invalidSource keeps the previous view.

incompleteSource.description: The collection whose document failed validation (eventAssistanceCases, eventAttendees, events or organizers), or null when coverage is complete.

view.description: The manager row; null only when the first evaluation was already invalid.
